{{Top|leg}}
An '''Arena Complex''' was a type of [[Complex]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Arena Complexes were fully inclosed, testing the rider's skill at guiding the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] through tight confines. The [[Emperor's Palace (swoopchasing)|Emperor's Palace]] was an Arena Complex.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
